label: Extranuclear EXISTENCE_4 of an object in a nuclear-property object theory
definition: ExistsExtranuclear x: object x exists, with existence read as an extranuclear property of objects (Parsons-style reconstruction of Meinong's Sein). Objects that lack it (the golden mountain, the round square) are still objects with nuclear properties (Aussersein, independence of Sosein from Sein). It is not a nuclear property, so no characterization can confer it. When a nuclear-property theory is used as a definitional frame, its existent objects are the beings.
note: Analyst reconstruction, attribution deferred (Parsons 1980 and Meinong 1904/1907 are navigation, not pinned witnesses). Distinct from EXISTENCE_1 (Russell's nonempty propositional function), EXISTENCE_3 (world-relative actuality ActualAt) and EXISTENCE_5 (the watered-down nuclear existent).

formal_gap.meaning: ExistsExtranuclear x: x is among what exists; a property of objects outside the nuclear class, so not part of any object's characterizing set.
examples: On the reconstruction, Mont Blanc has it; the golden mountain and the round square lack it while having their nuclear properties.
exclusions: Being an object at all: nonexistent objects are objects.
open_obligations: Whether extranuclear existence entails nuclear existence is not assumed (it holds in the recorded model, by construction).
Its identification with the quarta via's being in act at esse or with the root's domain of beings is an explicit reading, not a theorem.
